caption: The same tomato red in three notations. Read the hex row digit by digit: FF is 255, and hue 9° with full saturation gives back the same colour.

spec.title: One colour in three notations
spec.aria: The same colour written three ways: hex FF 63 47, rgb 255 99 71, and hue 9, saturation 100 percent, lightness 64 percent.
